content:
**Grilled Hermit Crab** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

A piece of Hermit Crab Meat which has been grilled over an open flame, making it safer to eat and improving its nutritional value.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Hermit Crab Meat (1) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Hermit Crab Meat | | Grilled Hermit Crab (1) | 

- Can be crafted at any Cooking Station with the correct ingredients, after having picked up Hermit Crab Meat for the first time.
- May be sold by Mr. Waiter at the dining room inside the Whitespring Resort.
